pictures.deviceText: Ana ƙirƙira su a nan, a sirri kuma kyauta, har ma ba tare da intanet ba. Ana fara duba kowanne a nan: ana ƙin hotunan da ke nuna tsiraici, jima’i ko cutar da kai.
pictures.suggestive: Ƙi hotuna masu tayar da sha’awa ma
pictures.suggestiveText: Har da ƙananan kayan iyo da na ciki, da salon tsayuwa masu tayar da sha’awa. Ana ƙin tsiraici da jima’i koyaushe.
pictures.hateText: Alamomi da farfagandar Nazi, ta’addanci da sauran tsattsauran ra’ayi. Kashe shi don tarihi, koyarwa ko rahoto.
pictures.violenceText: Jini, yanke gaɓoɓi, munanan raunuka da gawawwaki. Ana barin yaƙe-yaƙe da faɗa ba tare da su ba.
pictures.sd-turbo.text: Hotuna masu murabba’i cikin ’yan daƙiƙoƙi, ta SD-Turbo na Stability AI, ƙarƙashin lasisin al’ummarsa.
pictures.flux2-klein.text: Hotuna mafi kyau a kowace siffa, cikin kusan minti ɗaya, ta FLUX.2 [klein] na Black Forest Labs, ƙarƙashin lasisin Apache 2.0. Shi kaɗai ne yake iya canza hoto ma. Yana buƙatar sabuwar kwamfuta mai ƙwaƙwalwa ta 16 GB.
pictures.z-image-turbo.text: Hotuna mafi kyau a kowace siffa, da kalmomi da aka rubuta daidai, cikin kusan rabin minti, ta Z-Image-Turbo na Alibaba, ƙarƙashin lasisin Apache 2.0. Yana buƙatar sabuwar kwamfuta mai ƙwaƙwalwa ta 16 GB.
pictures.fastwan.text: Bidiyo na daƙiƙa biyar a kowace siffa daga bayani, cikin 'yan mintuna, ta FastWan 2.2 na FastVideo, ƙarƙashin lasisin Apache 2.0. Yana buƙatar sabuwar kwamfuta mai ƙwaƙwalwa ta 16 GB.
pictures.filmsText: Ana ƙirƙirar bidiyo ba tare da tambaya da farko ba.
pictures.saveLabelled: Adana hoton da alamar “Ƙirƙirarriyar basira ce ta yi”
